summary: The OnixEdit plugin integrates Barkpark with the Norwegian book trade standard ONIX 3.0 and the Bokbasen distribution channel. It provides bidirectional ONIX 3.0 XML conversion (import + XSD-validated export), automated publish-on-save to Bokbasen via lifecycle hooks, a Studio admin surface, and codelist drift detection.

intentions.title: Emit standards-compliant ONIX 3.0 XML for trade distribution
intentions.evidence: export.ex builds full EDItEUR-conformant ONIXMessage trees (DescriptiveDetail, CollateralDetail, PublishingDetail, ProductSupply); export_controller.ex streams XSD-gated XML at GET /v1/plugins/onixedit/export/:dataset/:id.onix; to_iodata/1 refuses to emit invalid XML

intentions.title: Automate Bokbasen submission on normal publish (zero extra clicks)
intentions.evidence: lifecycle.ex registers an after_publish hook that enqueues Bokbasen.PublishWorker whenever a book document is published; recursion guard on ctx.source == :worker prevents infinite re-enqueue loops

intentions.title: Support round-trip ONIX import so external catalogs can be ingested
intentions.evidence: importer.ex parses ONIX 3.0 XML back to book content maps that byte-stably re-export through the same exporter; designed as the explicit inverse of export.ex

intentions.title: Surface Bokbasen dry-run preview and manual retry in Studio
intentions.evidence: actions.ex exposes publish_to_bokbasen/3 in :dryrun and :real modes; bokbasen_live.ex provides an admin LiveView for submission state; export_onix_path/2 renders a kind:link download action in the Studio schema registry

intentions.title: Detect and surface ONIX codelist version drift before submissions fail downstream
intentions.evidence: staleness_checker.ex classifies every pinned codelist ref as :current/:stale/:deprecated/:acknowledged against the current registry issue; staleness_live.ex surfaces this in a Studio admin panel; revalidate/2 computes the diff needed to bring a doc current

intentions.title: Enforce multi-tenant isolation on ONIX export
intentions.evidence: export_controller.ex loads documents via Content.get_document with scope_opts(conn) so a cross-workspace book never resolves; lifecycle.ex captures workspace_id/project_id into Oban job args so the worker re-reads the correct tenant's book
